exposure: induction of labor (IOL) at 39 weeks of gestation
outcome: motivation to join the WINDOW study
cohort: 25 pregnant women with obesity randomized to induction of labor at 39 weeks of gestation in the WINDOW study.
finding: Participants were primarily motivated by physical discomfort and the desire to control birth timing, and their IOL experiences varied from positive team efforts to prolonged labor and a perception of the body being 'reluctant' to induction.
